root_causes.cause: Production copy lagged behind ML NLP; it omitted status, patient context, duration and all negation checks.
Production aliases omitted struggling to breathe, losing weight and sneezing. Suggestions could offer wheezing for sneezing.
Broad same-prefix transposition heuristic admitted multi-edit substitutions; duration supported only exact English days/weeks; no severity; context words rendered as unmatched.

fixes: Synchronized extraction logic and added static parity regression for shared functions and catalogues.
Preserved recognised present/absent/unknown states and absent/uncertain arrays; unmentioned remains absent from recognised list.
Restricted automatic word typo matching to a single edit with same first character; multiword matching requires 95 similarity.
Extracted explicit English/Swahili durations/ranges; preserved vague duration text without fabricated numeric bounds.
Extracted mild/moderate/severe attributes and recognized uncertainty including Swahili.
Added DB/model-independent detect_safety_signs preserving negation and patient context.
Cached bundled warning-sign catalogue independently of normal DB extraction; reused DB aliases for unmatched cleanup so API catalogue use never falls back to JSON.
limitations: Rule-based NLP covers documented aliases and contextual patterns; arbitrary text is not proven safe or clinically validated.
Vague durations retain text with unknown numeric bounds; hours/months do not invent integer-day conversions.
Regular production catalogue must be re-seeded for new non-emergency aliases; emergency detection independently reads bundled catalogues.
Severity and duration are contextual attributes, not claimed trained model features.
